944 reviews. 4.4 stars. On a party island where bars open and close every season.

The Rabbit Hole Irish Bar on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo earns that rating the honest way. Cold drafts, live sports, a crowd that actually talks to each other. $15-30 a head gets you a proper night out, not a tourist trap bill.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
